name: layout/tilt-card
title: Tilt card
description: A card that tilts toward the pointer.

files.content:
export { TiltCard } from './TiltCard';
export type { TiltCardProps } from './TiltCard';

keyboard.action: Move to the controls inside; the card lifts while one is focused.

notes: The card is a plain container; it adds no role and no Tab stop of its own.
Tilt is pointer-only and never needed to read or use the content.
The sheen is decorative and ignores pointer events.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The card stays flat; there is no tilt and no sheen.
